name: jmargocubs Apps
subtitle: Kyro, Zepzi, and Sunny Meadow beta builds
description: Feather-compatible source for Kyro, Zepzi, and Sunny Meadow beta IPAs hosted on GitHub Releases.

apps.name: Kyro
apps.subtitle: Self-hosted media streaming client
apps.localizedDescription: Kyro is a customized iOS streaming client based on Silo, bringing your self-hosted media library together with an enhanced IPTV experience and Sports Hub features. Enjoy movies, TV shows, live channels, a personalized interface, and more in one app. Built for users who want greater control over their streaming experience. Sports Hub features are in development.

apps.name: Zepzi
apps.subtitle: Comic reader for Komga
apps.localizedDescription: Zepzi is a colorful, customizable comic-reading app for iPhone, built for readers who host their collections with Komga. Explore your library, enjoy a smooth reading experience, track your progress, unlock achievements, and personalize your adventure with unique themes.

apps.name: Sunny Meadow
apps.subtitle: Private recovery and mood journaling
apps.localizedDescription: Sunny Meadow is a calm, private iPhone app for mood check-ins and Recovery Journeys. Track how you feel, keep gentle recovery journeys with your own intention, and watch a Living Tree grow as you show up. Personal data stays on your device. This beta build is unsigned; testers must use their own signing setup.
